entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner has approached this Court being aggrieved by the judgment and order dated 28.07.2022 passed by the Division Bench of the High Court, thereby rejecting the application filed by the present petitioner for suspension of sentence.

2. The petitioner has been convicted for an offence punishable under Sections 366 and 376 (2) (n) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3(2) (v) of the SC/ST Act has been sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for life.
3. Taking into consideration the period of incarceration and the nature of evidence, we find that the petitioner is entitled for suspension of sentence.
4. During the pendency of the appeal before the High Court, we suspend the sentence of the petitioner.
5. The petitioner is directed to be released on bail in connection with SC ATR Case No. 9 of 2018, on such terms and conditions as may imposed by the learned Trial Court.
6. The special leave petition is, accordingly, disposed of.

7. Pending application(s), if any, stand disposed of.
(DEEPAK SINGH) (ANJU KAPOOR)
